Study the private multi-source question bank with DMBOK references

This private static app combines the original 490-question bank with the supplied Data Strategy Professionals sets and deduplicated DAMA practice-attempt questions. Imported items retain source provenance and source answers, and are tagged as DMBOK verified, corrected, source-conflict, or review.

Reference note. The question bank was written against DMBOK2 (2017), so the source page number is retained. The revised-edition page is a content match against the supplied 2024 edition. The original-bank reference corrections are retained, and imported-source disagreements are explicitly tagged rather than silently overwritten.

Choose a section or knowledge area on the left, set a session size, and start. Study mode can show feedback as you go. Exam mode hides answers until submission and uses a 54-second-per-question timer (90 minutes for 100 questions).

Your progress

Performance is stored only in this browser. Weak-area scores use your completed answers across study, missed-question, weak-area, and exam sessions.
